name: rightsize
description: Right-sizes each Claude Code prompt: rates the effort, model and cost it needs, then lowers or raises effort, or hands the work to a stronger or cheaper subagent, the way you chose the first time each case came up

floor.title: Lowest effort
floor.description: The lowest effort level rightsize will lower to.

billing.title: Reports
billing.description: api: subagent reports show dollars. subscription: they show the share of usage, with API prices beside it. Read off each response's rate limits when they show it; setting it here counts as your answer when they don't.

priceCheck.title: Price check
priceCheck.description: monthly: compare prices.json with Anthropic's pricing page every 30 days and update it. check now: check once right away, then back to monthly. off: never check.
